replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, I often feel anxious about math. It’s not a subject that comes naturally to me, and the pressure to understand complex formulas makes me stressed. I prefer subjects that are more about understanding people and stories.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: I haven’t used AI for math much. I’m a bit skeptical about it, but I know some friends use it. I still prefer asking teachers or friends for help. Maybe I’ll try it if I get more comfortable with the subject.
